_kiem_chung: Nhung dieu duoi day da quan sat truc tiep tren trang, khong phai suy doan:
- Muc luc tap ghi 'E1. Ten tap', nam trong <span> khong co class de bam,
nen auto-nhan-dang bang mau chu chay dung -> khong can episodeSelector.
- Header lai ghi 'Ep 1 - Ten tap', tuc trang dung LAN hai kieu danh so.
Bo loc nhom-dong-nhat da xu ly, khong can khai bao gi them.
- <h1> chua CA ten tac pham lan ten tap, co cho viet 'EP-36' co gach noi.
Ham cat ten tap da nhan duoc dang nay.
- Muc luc tai dan khi cuon; mot bo co the hon 1000 tap.
- Stream khong ma hoa, khong DRM ('Key system access true' trong log chi
la tham do EME, khong phai dau hieu co DRM).
- Moi tap sinh ra mot master playlist va vai playlist con cung thu muc.
Chua kiem chung: cac truong duoi day de trong vi auto-nhan-dang da du.
Neu ban chay va thay sai o dau, dien selector cu the vao day.
notes: Co phan mien phi o dau bo, phan sau tra phi. Tap tra phi khong phat duoc nen khong sinh link - auto_grab.js se tu dung o ranh gioi do.
